hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: Small body near the top with a long lower wick (2× body or more). After a downtrend, buyers pushed price back up — strong potential reversal signal.

invertedHammer.name: Inverted Hammer
invertedHammer.desc: Small body near the bottom with a long upper wick. Buyers attempted a rally; sellers couldn't sustain the pressure — watch for follow-through confirmation.

bullishEngulfing.name: Bullish Engulfing
bullishEngulfing.desc: A large green candle completely engulfs the prior red candle's body. Strong reversal signal — buyers have taken decisive control from sellers.

piercingLine.name: Piercing Line
piercingLine.desc: Green candle opens below the prior red candle's low but closes above its midpoint. Shows buyers stepping in aggressively after a flush lower.

morningStar.name: Morning Star
morningStar.desc: Three-candle reversal: large red, small indecisive candle, then large green. Classic bottom-reversal pattern showing increasing buyer conviction.

threeWhiteSoldiers.name: Three White Soldiers
threeWhiteSoldiers.desc: Three consecutive green candles, each opening near the prior close and closing higher. Signals a powerful, sustained shift to buying pressure.

bullishHarami.name: Bullish Harami
bullishHarami.desc: A small green candle entirely within the prior large red candle's body. The downtrend is losing momentum — a reversal may be near.

dragonflyDoji.name: Dragonfly Doji
dragonflyDoji.desc: Open, high, and close near the top with a very long lower wick. Sellers drove price down hard but buyers fully reclaimed — strong demand signal.

shootingStar.name: Shooting Star
shootingStar.desc: Small body near the low with a long upper wick (2× body or more). At market tops, buyers rallied but sellers crushed them back — potential reversal.

hangingMan.name: Hanging Man
hangingMan.desc: Looks like a hammer but forms at the top of an uptrend. The long lower wick reveals growing selling pressure even though bulls recovered for now.

bearishEngulfing.name: Bearish Engulfing
bearishEngulfing.desc: A large red candle completely engulfs the prior green candle's body. Strong reversal signal — sellers have taken decisive control from buyers.

darkCloudCover.name: Dark Cloud Cover
darkCloudCover.desc: Red candle opens above the prior green candle's high but closes below its midpoint. Shows sellers aggressively stepping in at elevated prices.

eveningStar.name: Evening Star
eveningStar.desc: Three-candle reversal: large green, small indecisive candle, then large red. Classic top-reversal showing buyers exhausted and sellers taking over.

threeBlackCrows.name: Three Black Crows
threeBlackCrows.desc: Three consecutive red candles, each opening near the prior close and closing lower. Signals a powerful, sustained shift to heavy selling pressure.

bearishHarami.name: Bearish Harami
bearishHarami.desc: A small red candle entirely within the prior large green candle's body. The uptrend is losing steam — watch for a breakdown below support.

gravestoneDoji.name: Gravestone Doji
gravestoneDoji.desc: Open, low, and close near the bottom with a very long upper wick. Buyers pushed hard but sellers fully reclaimed — strong supply rejection signal.
